title: Adult with external gills
hook: Some adult animals retain juvenile features.

knows: Animals have structures and behaviors that can be investigated.
doesNotKnow: The diagram highlights external gills beside an adult axolotl and depicts eggs as evidence of reproduction in this scenario. Axolotls commonly mature while retaining larval characteristics; the sketch is not evidence that every individual follows an identical path.

misconception: The evidence in the scenario supports a different interpretation.
objective: A reproductively mature axolotl still has a feature usually associated with a larval form. Which feature can it retain?

claims.text: The scene stipulates reproduction and highlights gills; external anatomy and reproductive stages are simplified.
